notices.title: PoH v3 Blake3 activation
notices.body: At chain height 500000 (override HACKME_POH_V3_ACTIVATION_HEIGHT in lab), PoH work becomes Blake3(prev_hash || miner_address || nonce_le) with little-endian uint64 work % M == 0. Pre-activation keeps eval(n)=7n+13. Economics (~30s, 0.01 HMC) unchanged. Update workerpoh before the gate.

notices.title: Attempt-pay sampled recheck
notices.body: Public pool attempt accrual (payout_found_only=0) now samples ~1% of found=false submits and rejects missed_found_unreported if the lease prefix contains a valid PoH hit you did not report. Keep mining honestly; found-only mode skips this path.
